stories.title: Dode vinvis van 11 meter aangespoeld op strand Ameland: 'Niet veel van over'

en.title: Dead whale of 11 meters washed ashore on Ameland beach: 'Not much left'
en.summary: An 11-meter-long dead whale washed ashore on a beach in Ameland on Friday morning. The carcass, which has been dead for some time, remains on the beach.

stories.title: Kabinet laat onderzoek doen naar misstanden bij zaaddonaties

en.title: Government launches investigation into seed donation abuses
en.summary: The Dutch health ministry is commissioning an independent historical investigation to understand how irregularities in donor conception practices have occurred.

stories.title: Pro in Europa bij sociaaldemocraten; Kitty Jong wordt partijvoorzitter

en.title: Pro in Europe with social democrats; Kitty Jong becomes party chairman
en.summary: Kitty Jong, former FNV vice-chair, was elected chair of Progressive Netherlands (Pro) with over 50 percent of votes. Members voted 65 percent in favor of joining the European social democrats rather than the Greens.

stories.title: Minderheidskabinet spreekt met oppositie over 'nieuw, aantrekkelijk aanbod'

en.title: Minority cabinet speaks with opposition about 'new, attractive offer'
en.summary: The Dutch minority government continues negotiations with opposition parties on budget support. Premier Jetten announced a new package addressing purchasing power, social security, and wealth tax aimed at securing support from both left and right.

stories.title: Boodschappendienst Flink getroffen door digitale gijzeling, ook klanten onder druk gezet om losgeld te betalen

en.title: Delivery service Flink hit by digital extortion, customers also pressured to pay ransom
en.summary: The grocery delivery service Flink has been affected by a digital extortion attack, with customers being targeted for ransom payments as well.

stories.title: Pro sluit zich aan bij Europese Socialisten, oud-FNV’er Kitty Jong nieuwe partijvoorzitter

en.title: Pro joins European Socialists, former FNV member Kitty Jong new party chair
en.summary: Progressief Nederland has voted to join the European Socialist Party at the European level, with party members approving the decision through referendum. Kitty Jong, a former FNV official, has been appointed as the new party chairperson.

stories.title: Pro sluit zich in Europa aan bij de Europese socialisten, Kitty Jong partijvoorzitter

en.title: Pro joins European socialists in Europe, Kitty Jong party chairperson
en.summary: Progressief Nederland has aligned itself with the European Socialists at the European level, with Kitty Jong becoming the party's chairperson.

stories.title: Kabinet stelt afspraak met Tata Steel vijf maanden uit

en.title: Cabinet postpones agreement with Tata Steel by five months
en.summary: The Dutch government and Tata Steel have agreed to delay a customized agreement by five months, following four years of negotiations regarding the country's largest CO2 emitter.

stories.title: Boodschappendienst Flink gehackt, klanten ontvangen afpersingsmail

en.title: Grocery delivery service Flink hacked, customers receive extortion emails
en.summary: Customers of delivery service Flink received extortion emails following a data breach. A group calling itself LPG Group is demanding approximately 10 euros in cryptocurrency from individual customers.

stories.title: Kabinet stelt deadline voor akkoord met Tata Steel vijf maanden uit, verbod op gebruik staalslakken is prominent pijnpunt

en.title: Cabinet delays deadline for Tata Steel agreement by five months, steel slag ban is major sticking point
en.summary: The Dutch government has postponed its deadline for reaching an agreement with Tata Steel by five months. The use of steel slag remains a prominent point of contention in negotiations.

stories.title: Hackers persen klanten boodschappendienst Flink af: betalen of data gepubliceerd

en.title: Hackers extort Flink grocery delivery service customers: pay or data published
en.summary: An unknown hacker group claims to have breached grocery delivery service Flink and is demanding payment from customers and employees, threatening to publish their data. The group is requesting 10 to 15 euros in cryptocurrency per person by October 2.

stories.title: Kabinet stelt besluit over toekomst Tata Steel halfjaar uit

en.title: Cabinet postpones decision on future of Tata Steel six months
en.summary: The Dutch government and Tata Steel have agreed to extend their deadline for sustainability measures negotiations until March of next year. The original deadline of September 30 has been moved to March 1 to allow further discussions.
